queries:
WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS average_wins
    FROM driverStandings AS ds
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM race_averages
    GROUP BY country
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM country_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins
    FROM country_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ca.average_wins > oa.average_wins
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    aa.country,
    aa.average_wins,
    ABS(aa.average_wins - oa.average_wins) AS above_overall_average,
    ABS(aa.average_wins - ga.average_wins) AS above_group_average
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga
WHERE aa.average_wins > ga.average_wins;
WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS average_wins
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM results AS res
        WHERE res.raceId = ds.raceId
          AND res.driverId = ds.driverId
    )
    GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM race_averages
    GROUP BY country
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM country_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins
    FROM country_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ca.average_wins > oa.average_wins
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.country,
       aa.average_wins,
       aa.average_wins - oa.average_wins AS above_overall_average,
       aa.average_wins - ga.average_wins AS above_group_average
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga
WHERE aa.average_wins > ga.average_wins;
WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS average_wins
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country,
           AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins,
           COUNT(*) AS race_count
    FROM race_averages
    GROUP BY country
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT SUM(average_wins * race_count) / SUM(race_count) AS average_wins
    FROM country_averages
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT ca.*
    FROM country_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ca.average_wins > oa.average_wins
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT SUM(average_wins * race_count) / SUM(race_count) AS average_wins
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.average_wins,
       ABS(a.average_wins - o.average_wins) AS above_overall_average,
       ABS(a.average_wins - g.average_wins) AS above_group_average
FROM above_overall AS a
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.average_wins > g.average_wins;

country_averages AS (

above_overall AS (
    SELECT ca.*
